sources.entry: OpenCloud - File Sharing and Collaboration Platform. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker/Go/Nodejs
OpenCloud | File sync and share platform, a fork of ownCloud Infinite Scale

summary.one_liner: OpenCloud is a self-hosted file sync and sharing platform written in Go, forked from ownCloud Infinite Scale, and this repository holds its server backend.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the Go codebase for the OpenCloud server backend. The README describes how to build it with make generate, which produces assets such as the web UI and the builtin identity provider, followed by make -C opencloud build to produce an opencloud binary. Running opencloud init followed by opencloud server creates a configuration in $HOME/.opencloud and starts a local test instance. Authentication uses OpenID Connect, either with an external IdP such as Keycloak or the embedded LibreGraph Connect identity provider. The backend uses no database and stores all data in the filesystem under $HOME/.opencloud by default. The README is mainly a developer-oriented build guide; general installation details are said to be on the OpenCloud website and in the Development Documentation.
use_cases: running a private cloud storage backend
notable: No database: all data is stored in the filesystem
Supports an external OpenID Connect IdP such as Keycloak
caveats: README is a developer-focused build guide; end-user installation is referred to external documentation
Setup and installation options are deferred to the Development Documentation
